omissions.original: Register and memory access coordination: ADSP executes ADSP firmware for OTP boot/write/test and signal elaboration, using mapped program/data/register memory and soft-reset handling. Regmap implements the mapped AFE, system, and OTP registers, exposing configuration/status while enforcing reset and OTP write-protection rules. BIST Controller controls BIST operating modes and coordinates ADC/OTP test operations and their register-visible results. I2C_SPI_AHB accepts I2C/SPI accesses and translates them as needed into AHB transactions for device configuration and readback, including ISPU access. SPI interface provides SPI register transactions to Regmap. I2C interface provides I2C register transactions to Regmap. Regmap provides register read response to SPI interface and I2C interface.
